Conversational contacts (people_* intents): archives a contact's memory rows when the contact is renamed (review archive).
services/zoe-data/correction_apply.py: A spoken correction ("X is their dog", a day-first date) rewrites the stored fact (review edit) and ingests the corrected one; ZOE_CORRECTION_APPLY.
services/zoe-data/expert_dispatch.py: Tier-1.5 domain experts: stores a voice_fact, retires the fact it replaces (review archive) and supersedes on a stated change.
services/zoe-data/hindsight_retain_candi: Hindsight evaluation path: creates a PENDING row for later admission (ingest). Not on the live turn path.
services/zoe-data/hold_the_fact.py: Hold the fact: restores the owner's stated value after a model pushback (review edit); ZOE_HOLD_THE_FACT.
services/zoe-data/intent_router.py: Intent-first router: the 'remember that' / 'forget that' / 'forget the last thing' fast paths (ingest, forget_last, review reject/archive).
services/zoe-data/mcp_server.py: MCP tools for Hermes/Pi skills: memory_add (ingest, brain_tool/mcp source) and the forget/edit tools (review).
services/zoe-data/memory_digest.py: The nightly digest and dreaming passes: ingests digest facts/candidates, edits/archives/merges rows (review, archive_duplicate, sweep_soft_archive) and runs raw upserts for neighbour metadata and synthesis rows.
services/zoe-data/memory_disputes.py: A held-back write becomes one question to the person: accepting approves the candidate, declining rejects it (review).
services/zoe-data/memory_extractor.py: The per-turn extractor (regex + LLM, chat_regex/voice_regex): ingests new facts and edits a same-attribute row on a stated change (review edit).
services/zoe-data/memory_retire.py: Quote-backed retirement: a one-word change of state ("I gave up the cello") retires the right fact with the owner's words attached (retire_with_quote).
services/zoe-data/memory_service.py: The STORAGE LAYER (funnel): its own raw drawers writes - _write_row, restore, compaction, and the drawers-index rebuild (_rebuild_drawers: create_collection then add). Every other writer should reach the store through MemoryService, not around it.
services/zoe-data/memory_space.py: The panel's Memories space: per-item forget (review reject, with the exact-words twin).
services/zoe-data/memory_supersede.py: Implicit supersession: a stated change of state retires the fact it replaces (supersede_by); ZOE_MEMORY_IMPLICIT_SUPERSEDE.
services/zoe-data/mempalace_baseline.py: Benchmark fixtures: ingests synthetic rows to score the store. Bench/lab use; never real members.
services/zoe-data/named_relations.py: Named people after a relationship noun are kept, never summarised to a count (ingest, review edit).
services/zoe-data/omi_review_apply.py: Approve a pendant day-review candidate: the ONLY module that writes what the Omi day review proposed (ingest).
services/zoe-data/person_extractor.py: Person-fact extraction from conversation: ingests person rows and queues candidates (record_candidate), edits via review under the memory-authority wall.
services/zoe-data/provenance_answers.py: "Why did you say that?", the one-sentence fix, "forget that" and off-the-record: rejects the rows a forget or correction names (review reject).
services/zoe-data/routers/journal.py: Journal API: a journal entry is mirrored into memory (ingest).
services/zoe-data/routers/memories.py: The memories API: the explicit add/edit/review endpoints, plus the admin forget and the internal forget-synthetic teardown (ingest, review, delete_user).
services/zoe-data/routers/notes.py: Notes API: a note is mirrored into memory (ingest).
services/zoe-data/routers/people.py: People API: ingests person facts and archives a person's rows when the person is removed or merged (ingest, archive_by_entity).
services/zoe-data/routers/user_profile.p: User profile API: profile facts are mirrored into memory (ingest).
services/zoe-data/skybridge_service.py: Skybridge card actions: a fact the member confirms on a card is stored (ingest, source skybridge_action).
services/zoe-data/trait_challenge.py: The owner hedges or denies a trait Zoe holds about them: parks the matching approved row as pending (flag_challenged); text and provenance untouched, an approve restores it.
services/zoe-data/zoe_agent.py: The agent loop's memory tool (ingest, brain_tool/zoe_agent source) and a one-time startup migration of legacy palace rows (a RAW upsert that bypasses the funnel).
services/zoe-data/zoe_memory_prompt_pack: Measurement helper: ingests fixtures to time the prompt packet. Bench use; never real members.
